desc: Real Avid Prime-223 is a comprehensive cleaning kit designed specifically for .223/5.56 caliber rifles. This all-in-one set includes purpose-built tools and accessories to thoroughly remove fouling, carbon, and debris from barrels and actions, keeping your rifle running smoothly and accurately. Durable, easy-to-use components make maintenance fast and efficient a must-have for range days, routine care, and precision performance.
